feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 September 2026 11:40am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 05 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of the British Isles builds a brief ridge across the area today.


##Wind##

West, backing south later, 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 overnight. Occasionally 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain arriving overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, although occasionally 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area at first, veering west 4 or 5 overnight into Monday, before increasing southwest 5 or 6 late Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight for a time later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
